title: Tests cannot write into the real repo's git dir
lead: A test fixture under a TMPDIR inside the checkout can never write into the real repository's git common dir, and the suite fails if any test does.
findings_note: s298 relay 2026-10-16: mutation runs leaked 150 fixture lines into .git/slicer
boundary: **Not in this slice:** changing production git discovery.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
During the s298 relay (2026-10-16), mutation runs with TMPDIR in `<worktree>/.venv/tmp/` wrote 150 lines of fixture runs into the real `.git/slicer/relay-runs.jsonl`. A fixture that is not its own git repo sits inside this repo, so git discovery reached the real common dir once the mutated code dropped its `at_worktree_root` check. AGENTS.md recommends an in-checkout TMPDIR, and every relay brief sets one. The fix round wrapped those fixtures in `support.isolated_discovery`, but nothing stops the next slice that writes to a git-dir path from doing the same, and the real ledger is now shared by every worktree.

**Owner decision (open):**
- (a) **Recommended.** `tests/support.py` takes a fingerprint of the real git common dir's `slicer/` at import, and a final test module (or `tests/affected.py` and the discover wrapper) checks it is unchanged, failing with the paths that changed.
- (b) Test fixture helpers set `GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES` to the fixture's parent for every fixture. That is suite-wide, which AGENTS.md currently advises against for `isolated_discovery`.
- (c) Docs only: AGENTS.md and the relay brief say to run mutations of git-dir code with a TMPDIR fixture that is its own git repo.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- Under (a): `tests/support.py`, a new `tests/test_zz_no_git_dir_writes.py` (or the equivalent hook), `AGENTS.md` (Commands).
- `CHANGELOG.md` is not needed (tests only).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: - Under (a): a test that writes a line into a scratch stand-in for the common dir makes the guard fail, and an untouched one passes.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Settle the owner decision.
2. Build the guard; prove it red by re-introducing the s298 leak in a mutant on a scratch copy.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - The full suite passes, and the real `.git/slicer/` fingerprint is the same before and after.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch; the owner lands it.
